{{Top|leg}}
A '''door cutter''' was a device employed by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] to gain entry to locked doors. The [[D'larah City Patrol]] used door cutters to breach the sealed door leading to [[Docking Bay 24]] at [[D'larah starport]].
